integrity: Proof and independent finite-state exact-arithmetic checks supplied. The epidemic-percolation representation is explicitly credited to earlier work. Historical novelty has residual priority risk; no independent mathematical audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite fixed core b>=2, complete bipartite graph, one core seed, independent directed Poisson contact processes, positive a.s.-finite core infectious periods, peripheral finite positive mean; contact rate lambda_n->0 and n*lambda_n->infinity. The exact finite formulas assume all infectious periods are unit-rate exponential. The result does not cover growing core width or epidemic duration.
title: A square-root cascade law for finite-core SIR epidemics on complete bipartite graphs
